# Daily Report — 2026-08-28

## Task Completed
Added `archive_knowledge_article` tool to `knowledge_base.py`. The tool PATCHes
`kb_knowledge/{sys_id}` with `workflow_state=retired`, retiring the article from
the knowledge base. An optional `retire_reason` field is stored as a work note on
the article. A 404 guard returns a descriptive failure response when the article
is not found. The tool is registered in the `knowledge_author` and `full` packages.
